component.name: Rewamp
component.summary: Chiptune, tracker and console music player

description.p: Rewamp plays the music of the machines that made it. Not recordings — emulation. A .sid runs on an emulated 6581, a .nsf on the NES sound hardware, a .mod through a real Amiga Paula mixer. What you hear is the chip doing the work, exactly as it did on the original hardware.
More than 35 audio engines cover over 1,200 file extensions:

ul.li: Tracker modules — MOD, XM, S3M, IT, MPTM, and dozens of older Amiga and PC formats
Amiga — 300+ custom-player formats through a full 68k emulator (TFMX, Hippel, Future Composer, David Whittaker…)
Commodore 64 — SID, with HVSC song lengths and STIL credits
Nintendo — NSF, GBS, SPC, GSF, 2SF, NCSF, SNSF, USF
Sega, NEC, SNK — VGM, S98, HES, SGC, SSF, DSF
Computers — MSX, ZX Spectrum, Atari ST and 8-bit, Amstrad CPC, PC-98, X68000, FM Towns, AdLib OPL2/OPL3
Game streams — 700+ container formats via vgmstream
Also MIDI with SoundFonts, SunVox, PxTone, Organya and Furnace
Oscilloscope — stereo, or one trace per voice with the real channel names
Spectrum — five looks, from classic bars to a full-screen beam and a polar ring
Notation — every note as it plays, with vibrato, pan and zoom
Pattern — the tracker view, in the original font, with VU meters per channel
Milkdrop — the full projectM engine and its preset library

description.p: Mute any voice, isolate a single channel, and hear how the track was built. Search a large online archive of chip and tracker music by title, artist, group, platform or format; browse by demoparty, production or year. Downloads live in your library and play without a connection.
An account is optional and never required. With one, your library, playlists and favourites follow you to your other devices.

screenshot.caption: The player, with the per-voice oscilloscope

ul.li: New "Podiums" browser: demoscene competition winners by party, year or kind of compo, with a hall of fame
Opening a slow track no longer freezes the app; a thin ring around play/pause shows it is still loading
Arcade: Ensoniq ES5505/ES5506 (Taito F3) and ZSG-2 (Taito Zoom) music now plays, and the engines are up to date (FM-Kingtracker .fmk added)
VGM: looping tracks end with an adjustable fade-out (0 to 16 s, 5 by default)
Info panel: format, engine, channels and loop points come first
Per-voice oscilloscope shows up to 64 voices
Piano visualizer: songs with many voices or instruments at once are spread over more keyboards
Amiga: StoneTracker, SUNtronic (TSM rips) and more Soundtracker 2.6 modules now play
ZX Spectrum: zxart .mt3 files play, and the ZXTune formats and SAM Coupé .cop programs are included
Dropped files are queued in the order they were displayed
Fixed: crashes with some .mtc files and with Apple IIGS VGM files; with crossfade on, tracks shorter than the fade can be heard again
Playback speed from 0.2× to 3×; most engines keep the pitch
New players: NoiseTracker GS (Apple IIGS), Ron Klaren (Amiga) and SAM Coupé .cop programs
More Amiga and Atari ST formats play: SidMon 1, Sonic Arranger, Paul Robotham, Quartet, SoundFactory
MSX MoonBlaster songs load their sample kit instead of playing noise
Library: hide items not on this device
Long-press the player artwork to see it full screen
Visualizer defaults: per-voice oscilloscope, and the line spectrum for streamed formats; steadier stereo oscilloscope
Fixed: tapping a track of some PSF-family albums played another track
A folder with several playlists now forms one album with every track
Visualizers now work under X11, including Steam Deck game mode
"Always on top" is back under X11
Closing the window no longer crashes the app
Game Boy .gbr and DefleMask .dmf files play
Smoother player and visualizers
Long titles scroll in a one-way loop
projectM preset packs install up to nine times faster
Fixed: pausing could skip to the next track
Single-archive PSF albums unfold into their tracks
Covers load much faster
Roland MT-32 engine for game MIDI, with your own ROMs
Ten rare module formats, and every track of Westwood .adl files
Instruments named and coloured in the visualizers
Search: filter demoscene competition winners
Subsongs shorter than a threshold are left out of Play all
Import a whole folder, and organise your folders
Fixed: wrong song on PC Engine, Master System and SNDH files
Fixed: MIDI drums no longer play as a piano
Far less processor and battery when nothing is playing
